# 1. Introduction

We study how index inclusion affects stewardship engagement. We find that newly included firms receive more engagement letters.

# 4. Results

Table 3 reports the main estimates. We find that firms added to the S&P 500 receive 0.8 more engagement letters per year from the three largest index fund families in the two years after inclusion (column 1). We also show that the increase is concentrated among firms with staggered boards (column 3). We document in Table 4 that the effect disappears for firms whose index weight is below the median. Figure 2 plots the estimates by index-weight decile; our results indicate that engagement responds to index weight rather than to firm size.

# 5. Robustness

We further find that the results are unchanged when we drop financial firms and utilities (Internet Appendix Table IA.2).
